Leadership is clearly in Precious Metals (Gold Miners, then Silver & Royalties) on high durability and full breadth, but momentum rank is not a return forecast, so I treat this as a trend-following, vol-aware focus lens only.
emerging_watch: Watch Silver & Royalties: if its durability bar (0.77) pushes above 0.85 while its momentum score stays above 1.5 and crowding_z stays below 1.0, a confirmed leadership handoff from Gold Miners may be forming.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the confirmed leader with the highest durability bar (0.85), full breadth (1.0), a trend Hurst tag, and no crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate supports a staying-power lean: priority is avoiding shake-out/drawdown rather than forecasting added return. I lean with the prevailing trend only while its eligibility and trend-health hold.
evidence: crowded false, eligible true, etf_proxy XGD.TO (scorable)
theses.dissent: The crowding_z of 0.95 is close to the flag threshold; if attention/flow turns, this concentrated single-theme leadership can unwind fast, and the detector's valid edge is risk control, not upside.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO drops back below the benchmark's absolute trend gate before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.23), which under the guardrails is a size-down caution, not a fade trigger. With a mixed Hurst tag and lower durability (0.76), the theme lacks the protecting trend-health of the top names yet carries the crowding texture. I mark it underweight relative to the leadership rather than initiating a contrarian fade.
evidence: rank 3, score 1.407, eligible but crowded true
theses.dissent: It still carries positive momentum and the crowding flag has no basket-level forward edge; copper fundamentals could continue to assert despite the texture.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO retains or exceeds XGD.TO on a trend-adjusted basis through the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology ranks 15th with the second-lowest momentum score (-1.045), a mixed Hurst tag, and no breadth support (0.8 breadth but negative momentum). The macro narrative is dominated by ai_tech headlines, but that is coincident macro context and explicitly not a per-theme buy trigger. Under the valid risk-control lens, this theme does not pass the focus filter.
evidence: rank 15, score -1.045, eligible true but near bottom
macro ai_tech dominance not a per-theme trigger
theses.dissent: A broad ai_tech macro narrative could rotate domestic capital flows into Canadian tech; momentum ranks are ~zero rank-IC and may miss a turn.
